scope: Independent bounded visual review of seven redesigned photo pages; no source or builder edits.

findings.layout: All seven asymmetric layouts are legible. Side captions have clear image associations; no visible collisions, clipped text, footer conflicts or orphan captions. White pages and restrained typography give variety without invented cultural decoration.
